pictureoftheday-not-scheduled: Shown when no dated entry, queue entry, or fallback entry is available.
pictureoftheday-invalid-file: Shown when an entry does not contain a valid file attribute.
pictureoftheday-invalid-start-date: Shown when the queue start date is invalid. $1 is the supplied date.
pictureoftheday-default-alt: Default alternative text for a picture.
pictureoftheday-file-details: Default link text leading to the file description and license page.
pictureoftheday-schedule-intro: Introduction above the queue preview. $1 is the number of days and $2 is the IANA time zone.
pictureoftheday-schedule-today: Label for the current day in the queue preview.
pictureoftheday-schedule-tomorrow: Label for the next day in the queue preview.
pictureoftheday-schedule-queue-position: Queue position label. $1 is the selected one-based item number and $2 is the number of queue entries.
pictureoftheday-schedule-override: Label indicating that a date-specific page overrides the rotating queue.
pictureoftheday-lookup-heading: Heading above the date lookup form.
pictureoftheday-lookup-description: Description explaining that the date lookup predicts the result under the current queue and overrides.
pictureoftheday-lookup-submit: Text on the date lookup submit button.
pictureoftheday-lookup-invalid-date: Error shown for an invalid lookup date. $1 is the supplied date.
pictureoftheday-lookup-result-heading: Heading above a date lookup result. $1 is the formatted date.
pictureoftheday-lookup-assumption: Notice explaining that the result can change if the queue or overrides are edited.
